final: WITH reference AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS overall_avg FROM compliancecase), status_averages AS (SELECT brokrepstat AS status, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), qualifying AS (SELECT s.status, s.avg_modelconf, s.avg_modelconf - r.overall_avg AS above_average FROM status_averages s CROSS JOIN reference r WHERE r.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s.avg_modelconf > r.overall_avg) SELECT status, avg_modelconf, above_average, avg_modelconf / AVG(avg_modelconf) OVER () AS ratio_to_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying
